concepts.title: 01 Control Room — editorial / command center
concepts.design_contract_summary: Settings as mission control: one dominant omni-search is the primary verb; primary destinations are large editorial panels (title + purpose + status + open affordance), never filter pills; notices carry one clear action; workspace is a book-TOC (left category index + continuous document); managers open as full-stage surfaces.

impacts.requirement: Primary Settings destinations must read as places opened, not filters applied; avoid pill silhouette and colored left-side borders (packet 01).
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Destinations rendered as large editorial panels with icon, title, purpose, status chip, and explicit 'Open' affordance.
supersedes_or_conflicts_with: legacy rounded category shortcuts / filter chips
test_impacts: assert no .pill silhouette on primary destinations
slint_notes: Grid panel layout translates to nested VerticalLayout/HorizontalLayout

impacts.requirement: Settings row model must make nine states unambiguous; blank fields cannot mean auto/inherit/disabled (packet 01).
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Every setting row carries an explicit state chip (Default/Recommended/Inherited/Auto/Not-configured/Managed/Custom/Unavailable/Effective-differs) and a value source.
test_impacts: assert no setting row uses blank to imply state
slint_notes: Row state is semantic, not DOM-derived

impacts.requirement: Search must remain the dominant discovery mechanism; fuzzy discovery across categories/settings and deep navigation to the result (packet 01).
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Dominant omni-search bar atop Home; results span settings/categories/managers/destinations; selecting deep-links to the owner category + subcategory and focus-flashes the setting.
test_impacts: smoke #1: search result opens correct category/subcategory/setting

impacts.requirement: Settings workspace must load one major category at a time as a continuous document with scrollspy + controlled jump (packet 01).
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Book-TOC: left category index, continuous doc pane, IntersectionObserver scrollspy with non-oscillating rootMargin, controlled smooth jump with focus-flash.
test_impacts: smoke #2: scroll changes active sub; smoke #3: jump lands at stable offset
slint_notes: IntersectionObserver is web-only; semantic active-sub state is portable; Slint needs a visibility/offset hook
notes: Scrollspy mechanism is the main Slint port surface

impacts.requirement: Assistant memory uses evidence-backed Gists with verification, provenance, scope, half-life (fades, not expires), version/repair (packet 03).
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Memory manager renders Gists with verified/awaiting-review states, kind, scope, half-life, pin, recall-strength bar, source, version count; actions verify/edit/pin/discard.
slint_notes: Strength bar is a pure height-from-state render
notes: Half-life is a fade, not an expiry — must not be presented as expiration

impacts.requirement: MCP manager: server identity/transport, install/connect/auth, health/reconnect, scope, discovered tools with progressive exposure, approval policy, logs (packet 04).
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: MCP manager renders servers with transport, scope, tools-exposed-of-total, approval duration, last-contact, reconnect on failure.
notes: Normal Settings must not become an approval-log viewer

impacts.requirement: Spellcheck is a quiet shared input service, not a Chat toolbar mode; production must use a Slint-portable spelling-service abstraction (packet 04).
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Concept demo: subtle wavy underline on misspellings via contenteditable + local dictionary; right-click suggestion menu (Replace-once / Ignore-once / Ignore-draft / Add-to-personal / Add-to-project); never autocorrects; skips code/URLs/paths/identifiers/model-names.
supersedes_or_conflicts_with: spellcheck as a Chat toolbar button
test_impacts: smoke #9: suggestions never replace text automatically
slint_notes: contenteditable + TreeWalker is browser-only; production uses a Slint-portable spelling-service abstraction. The dictionary/suggestion-menu/skip-logic contract is the portable part.
notes: Grammar/style is a separate optional feature requiring privacy/usage disclosure; off by default; not disguised as spellcheck.

impacts.requirement: Exposure levels: coherent treatment for Standard / Advanced / Expert-risky / Managed-read-only / Diagnostic / Unavailable (packet 01).
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Segmented control (Standard | Advanced | Expert) filters setting rows by exposure; managed/unavailable always show; search overrides the filter so advanced items remain discoverable.
schema_or_event_impacts: settings rows gain an exposure-level field
slint_notes: Model filter on settings list, not DOM show/hide

impacts.requirement: Motion must be film-level: directed continuity, clear staging, confident timing. Each concept should have its own coherent motion philosophy (packet 05).
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Shared motion.js helpers (FLIP, staggerIn, transitionView, smoothJump, pulseOnce, crossFade, growSettle) drive distinct choreographies per concept; reduced-motion reaches same final state per moment.
slint_notes: FLIP/stagger/view-swap are web-DOM-idiom; semantic state (expanded/active-sub/saved) lives in PM.state separate from geometry; Slint maps each to property/layout animations; reduced-motion fallbacks portable as-is
notes: No endless pulsing; layout settles before text revealed; no flashing on resize/refresh

impacts.requirement: Operational awareness: worktree provisioning, port-collision behavior, cross-project access off by default with separate read/write (packet 03).
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Operational-awareness subcategory with setting rows: worktree provisioning (Never/Ask/Always), port-collision (Fail/Ask/Auto-increment), cross-project read and write (separate, Off by default, Once/Thread/Goal/Persistent), test-automation, snapshot-access.
notes: Cross-project access off by default; read and write are separate grants

concepts.title: 02 Atlas — spatial / cartographic
concepts.design_contract_summary: Settings as territory: destinations are named regions with boundaries and a you-are-here marker; region size encodes density; workspace is focus+context (one region fills the canvas, a compact minimap keeps the whole map visible); search is a Cmd+K overlay.

impacts.requirement: Major Settings destinations must not look like filters and must support title/purpose/status/summary (packet 01).
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Destinations rendered as bounded regions on a 12-column grid; size scales with content density; needs-attention regions get a distinct border; you-are-here marker tracks current region.
slint_notes: 12-col grid + density sizing is a layout spec, translates to layout containers
notes: Density-encoding by region size is a new convention not in current Plans

impacts.requirement: Crew is Orchestrator-owned composition; requested vs effective members must be preserved (packet 03).
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Crew manager shows requested-members vs effective-members vs queued, concurrency req→eff, and a per-member admitted/queued list with the requested-vs-effective note.
notes: Crew selection in one thread/Goal must not change another

impacts.requirement: Skills/plugins/tools/commands are related but distinct; progressive disclosure is a runtime requirement (packet 04).
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Skills/Plugins/Tools manager renders distinct kinds with enabled/trust/scope, tool invocation state, command shortcuts, and update availability.
notes: Installed tool schemas must not be exposed to every agent by default

impacts.requirement: Design must translate cleanly to Slint 1.17.1; avoid DOM-measurement-as-semantic-state (packet 05).
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Minimap active-region and viewport-thumb position are derived from scroll, but the semantic active state is held in PM.state, not in DOM geometry.
slint_notes: Viewport thumb position is presentation of scroll, not semantic state; portable

concepts.title: 03 Stack — single surface / progressive disclosure
concepts.design_contract_summary: Settings never navigates away: one surface expands. Home is a prioritized stack (search head → notices → destination rows). Destinations are expandable rows that grow inline into the full workspace; one open at a time. Disclosure is the whole model.

impacts.requirement: Notices must distinguish needs-attention / continue-setup / recommended with one clear action; recommended must not look like an error (packet 01).
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Stack notices use distinct border tints (bad/warn/info) but never colored left-side bars; each has one headline, one consequence, one primary action.
supersedes_or_conflicts_with: Fix These / setup-suggestions / recents with layered repetition
notes: Avoid horizontal notice rails that cut off principal notices

impacts.requirement: Persona is behavior, not account/model/permission; explicit scope; child-only Personas must not appear as chat defaults (packet 03).
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Personas manager shows role, scope (turn/thread/goal/project/global/child-only), eligibility, behavior capsule; child-only flagged distinctly.
notes: Persona cannot widen Plan/Review mode, permissions, FileSafe, network, or parent-agent ceilings

impacts.requirement: Context & Instructions manager: durable breadth, narrow turn context; show what was admitted/omitted last turn; policy enforced outside the model (packet 03).
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Context manager shows admitted-last-turn vs omitted sources with reasons, AGENTS.md chain resolved, persona footprint, selected-vs-installed tools.
notes: FileSafe/permissions/routing/budgets enforced outside the model, not as prose instructions

impacts.requirement: No CSS-only behavior with no state model (packet 05).
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Expand-in-place uses explicit PM.state.expanded state + aria-expanded; the max-height transition is presentation only.
slint_notes: max-height animation is a web idiom; Slint animates height/layout; reduced-motion path is opacity-only and portable

concepts.title: 04 Stream — continuous navigable document
concepts.design_contract_summary: Settings as a river: persistent landmark rail of named markers + search + opening status beat; destinations are named sections; managers are channels within their section; scroll drives the landmark rail and a progress indicator.

impacts.requirement: Every required domain must remain discoverable; no domain hidden (packet 01).
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: All 11 categories render as sections in the river; 11 landmarks map 1:1 to sections; every domain reachable via landmark, scroll, or search.
test_impacts: assert every category has a section and a landmark
notes: Initial build had only 8 destination sections; fixed to 11 to cover all categories

impacts.requirement: LSP manager: installed/detected state, language coverage, executable/version, startup mode, capabilities/conflicts, health/restart/logs (packet 04).
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: LSP manager renders language servers with version, scope, startup mode, conflict count, restart/logs actions.

impacts.requirement: Terminal settings: profiles, shell, font, palette, opacity/material, cursor, transcript retention — not just shell + font size (packet 04).
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Terminal manager renders profiles with swatch preview, shell, font/size, opacity, and a live sample line; avoids empty Auto-detected/Inherit fields.

impacts.requirement: Media providers need the same connection/account/model rigor as coding providers, plus route/purpose, modality, native vs transformed, output, safety policy, cost, fallback, history (packet 02).
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Media manager renders routes with modality chips, native/PM-transformed, cost, policy (open/review), fallback.
notes: Do not copy Open Design's visual implementation one-to-one

impacts.requirement: No unbounded nested scroll containers (packet 05).
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: The river is one bounded scroller; manager channels render inside the section but use a single overflow host, not nested independent scrollers.
slint_notes: Single scroller with sections; channel bodies are not independent scroll containers

cross_concept_findings: All four concepts share one uniform manager shell (assets/managers.js) — proving the manager language is a system, not one provider screen. This is the single strongest cross-concept consistency.

All four avoid the banned anti-patterns (emoji, colored left-side status borders, primary category pills, raw internal labels, clipped text, fake no-op actions) — verified by static scan and visual review.
All four keep search central but give it a different home (dominant bar / Cmd+K overlay / stack head / river headwaters) — genuine divergence on the same requirement.
All four implement scrollspy/jump but with different mechanisms (TOC / minimap+viewport / subnav-in-expanded-row / landmark rail) — genuine divergence on workspace behavior.
The Glass one-backdrop-blur-over-pre-baked-wallpaper technique (from PMConcept7 T16) is reused consistently; glass manager overlays fall back to opaque plates to avoid nested backdrop-filter.
Requested-vs-effective state appears in all four wherever policy/runtime can diverge (Goal concurrency, Crew composition, agent role routing) — a system-wide semantic, not a one-off.
Category reorganization is shared: all four use the same humanized 11-category taxonomy, regrouped from the legacy implementation-bound list but preserving every required domain.
The settings row state model (nine states) is shared via assets/shared.js SettingRow — identical semantics across concepts.

Second pass added shared infrastructure used by all four: motion.js (distinct per-concept choreographies), spellcheck.js (packet-04 suggestion contract), exposure-level disclosure, reset-to-default, settings persistence, and theme-picker fixes. These raise every concept to the same completeness bar without homogenizing their IA.

Each concept now has a genuinely distinct motion philosophy (editorial-cinematic / cartographic-zoom / push-pop-depth / scroll-linked-flow) rather than four identical fade-ins — verified by per-concept keyframe + motion-helper usage.

Manager completeness raised across all four: PAM connections carry account-switching + repair/install/rescan; models carry hide/priority/structured-output/requested-vs-effective + evidence freshness; catalog carries validation/quarantine + change history; Terminal carries ANSI palette + cursor + CWD + retention; Skills/Plugins/Tools/Commands split into four distinct kinds with 5-state tools.
